items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 41:1
items.html: This world is phase four, and the lees of the Klipot of the thirty-two of the stone. However, the Partzufim of holiness were sorted only from the 288 sparks, and the 32 sparks of the thirty-two of the stone were pushed away from them, and in their place they received thirty-two aspects of Malchuts from Ima. And it is found that they have nothing at all of the aspect of the thirty-two of the stone. And in this manner were sorted the NRN and the body of Adam HaRishon — that is, all the 32 sparks of the thirty-two of the stone were pushed away from him, and in their place he received thirty-two Malchuts from Ima. And this is the secret that Adam HaRishon had nothing of this world. (Part 1, Page 942, subheading "and with this").
